Road conditions

  • http://www.tripcheck.com/Pages/RCmap.asp?curRegion=0&mainNav=RoadConditions (Road conditions map)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" Wide,
  • Over 14' High,
  • Over 53' Long

Special Information Needed

  • Oregon PUC #

Times Of Movement

½ before sunrise to½ hour after sunset

  • Daylight hours Sat. & Sun., except between Memorial Day to Labor Day, then allowed Sat. until noon, Sun.-no travel
  • Travel prohibited on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Christmas (from 2pm on last business day preceding observed holiday until ½ hour before sunrise of 1st business day following observed holiday) & from noon Wed. before Thanksgiving to ½ hour before sunrise on the Mon. following

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://egov.oregon.gov/ODOT/MCT/docs/PilotCarGuide.pdf
  • http://www.odot.state.or.us/forms/motcarr/od/1994.pdf
  • http://www.odot.state.or.us/forms/motcarr/od/2352.pdf
  • Please see permit- escort requirements depend on districts & highways

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: A passenger car, pickup, truck, or truck tactor of legal size & weight
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD” sign (5’ x 10”) w/ black letters (8” high x 1” brush stroke) on yellow background
  • Lights: 2 amber flashing lights (as widely spaced laterally as practical) w/ 4” lens diameter min. (35 candlepower rating min./30 flashes/min.) or revolving light (w/ minimum of 125 sq. in. of dome surface/emitting 30 flashes/min.) or strobe light(s) w/ 360 degree visibility mounted above roof (visible 500’)
  • Flags: 2 hand-held red flags 18” square mounted on 3’ long staffs
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio; 8 safety flares or reflectors

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • None specified

Dept. of Transportation Permits Office

  • Hours: 8:00a.m.-5:00p.m. M-F; PT
